description: Eurostat's dataset env_ww_con reports the share of each country's resident population connected to urban wastewater collecting systems and to urban wastewater treatment by level of treatment (primary, secondary and tertiary), together with population served by independent treatment and population not connected. It covers EU, EFTA and candidate countries from 1970 to 2024 with about 17,000 observations, comes from the joint OECD and Eurostat questionnaire on inland waters, and underlies the SDG indicator on population connected to at least secondary treatment (sdg_06_20) and the headline table ten00020. Data can be browsed or downloaded as TSV or CSV and queried through the SDMX and JSON APIs, free under Eurostat's reuse policy (CC BY 4.0). Caveats: coverage and years differ by country, with gaps and breaks in series, and figures are national aggregates, not plant data. Simulation uses: national sewer and treatment coverage for capacity planning of wastewater systems. Related record: the Urban Waste Water Treatment Directive plant data (data-uwwtd-treatment-plants).
name: Eurostat population connected to wastewater collection and treatment (env_ww_con)
notes: Treatment-level breakdown, the OECD/Eurostat joint questionnaire source and the CC BY 4.0 reuse policy are assistant recall and from the harvested descriptions of ten00020 and sdg_06_20; the data browser did not render the table.
